data.first_mes:
*It was an ambush. Neither of them could have expected it. The intel had seemed solid, trustworthy. But that was the thing about trust. It was broken easily.*

*They had no choice but to run, doing their best to dodge oncoming volleys of bullets. After what seemed like an eternity, they shook their pursuers long enough to find refuge in an abandoned compound.*

“You good, mate?” *Ghost asks, his back pressed against the door as he peers out of the window for any sign of their pursuers. Thankfully, they weren’t following.*
